name: BWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice across the promotion's return to television in 2001: the Journeyman Lance Nelson reclaimed it in a three-way dance, then lost it to a returning Attila at Meltdown.

name: BWF International Championship
epitaph: Inaugurated in a multi-man War Games match at Hotter Than Hell 2001, won by the Prophet, who carried it through the run.

name: BWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by Dennis Windham and Lance Nelson in a five-team elimination match at Hotter Than Hell 2001, then lost to the Deities at Meltdown.
